LAW 102.name: Roman Law
LAW 102.description: Introduction to fundamental legal concepts, legal thought and juristic reasoning; Foundations of Roman Private Law; Historical development of private law institutions; Important aspects of Roman private law - Law of persons, property, and obligations; Continuity of Roman law in modern civil law traditions.

LAW 103.name: Constitutional Law (in Turkish)
LAW 103.description: Definition of State, Sovereignty, Constitution, Constituent Power, Hierarchy of Norms, Constitutional Review, Political Systems (totalitarian, authoritarian, democratic systems), Governmental Systems (legislative, presidential parliamentarian, semi-presidential systems) (in Turkish).

LAW 104.name: Turkish Constitutional Law (in Turkish)
LAW 104.description: General overview of Ottoman-Turkish Constitutional Developments, General overview of Constitution of 1982, Characteristics of the Republic, Fundamental Rights and Freedoms, Legislative Power, Elections, Members of Parliament, Parliamentary Immunities, Executive Power, Judiciary, Constitutional Court and Constitutional Review. (in Turkish)

LAW 105.name: Civil Law: Introductory Provisions and Natural Persons (in Turkish)
LAW 105.description: Subject matter, historical background, sources and application of civil law; Basic Concepts: Right, acquisition of rights and legal transactions; good faith (bonafides); protection of rights; Natural Persons: Beginning and end of personality, capacities, protection of personality; Legal Persons. (in Turkish)

LAW 106.name: Legal Persons and Family Law (in Turkish)
LAW 106.description: Law of Marriage: Engagement (the legal nature, conditions for a valid engagement, legal effects of engagement, end of engagement); marriage (the legal nature, conditions for a valid marriage, general legal effects of marriage and matrimonial property systems, dissolution of marital bond and its legal consequences); legitimacy (affinity); establishment of legitimacy, adoption, annulment of legitimacy, recognition, paternity suit, legal effects of legitimacy and especially the parental power (patria potestas); Family in broader sense; Guardianship (guardianship in technical sense, curatorship, statutory advisors). (in Turkish)

LAW 201.name: Law of Obligations I (in Turkish)
LAW 201.description: Concepts of "obligational relationship" and "obligation", sources of obligations, formation and validity of legal transactions; particularly contracts, representation, torts and unjust enrichment. (in Turkish)

LAW 202.name: Law of Obligations II (in Turkish)
LAW 202.description: Performance of obligations, violation of obligations and its consequences, cease of obligations and some specialties related to obligations; namely conditional obligation, joint obligation, transfer of debt and assignment of obligation. (in Turkish)

LAW 203.name: Criminal Law I (in Turkish)
LAW 203.description: Legality, sources and application of the criminal laws; General theory of crime; elements of a crime; Actus reus and defenses; superior orders, necessity; Mens rea and crimes of negligence; mistake and ignorance of the laws. (in Turkish)

LAW 204.name: Criminal Law II (in Turkish)
LAW 204.description: Different aspects of a crime; accompliance, assistance after the offence, criminal attempt; Criminal responsibility; infancy, insanity; Theories of punishment; nature of punishment. Consequences and suspension of punishment. Amnesty; New perspectives in criminal law. (in Turkish)

LAW 205.name: Administrative Law (in Turkish)
LAW 205.description: Basic political and legal principles of Turkish administrative law; structural and functional aspects of central and local administrations, Rule-making power of administration. Unilateral administrative acts and contracts. Legal regime of public personnel and public domain. (in Turkish)

LAW 206.name: Administrative Judiciary (in Turkish)
LAW 206.description: Basic principles of judicial control of administration. Organization of administrative courts and Council of State; Judicial remedies (action for annulment and full remedy action); Liability of the administration and its agents. (in Turkish)

LAW 210.name: Basic Concepts of Law (in Turkish)
LAW 210.description: Sources of law. Social life and the law. Definitions and concepts. Division of public and private law. Branches of law. (in Turkish)

LAW 211.name: Basic Concepts of Law
LAW 211.description: Sources of law. Social life and the law. Definitions and concepts. Division of public and private law. Branches of law.

LAW 216.name: Introduction to Anglo-American Law
LAW 216.description: Fundamental concepts of Anglo-American law; the U.S. Constitution; the judiciary; Congress; the executive; equal protection; anti-discrimination; free speech; religious freedom; antitrust law; corporations; American criminal law.

LAW 217.name: Legal English
LAW 217.description: Basic concepts of English legal system. Introduction to English Contract law; specifically, formation and structure. Legal Profession in England and the USA. Legal language of banking. Legal and linguistic skills practice in reading, writing, drafting commercial agreements, oral presentation of case study, effective professional correspondence, negotiation, interviewing and advising clients.

LAW 301.name: Civil Procedure I (in Turkish)
LAW 301.description: Courts' structure, competence and venue, status of the plaintiff and the defendant, filing the lawsuit, submissions exchange, the trial, investigation, oral trial and judgment. (in Turkish)

LAW 302.name: Civil Procedure II (in Turkish)
LAW 302.description: The proof of claims, burden of proof, evidence, legal remedies, intermediate appeal and appeal procedures, arbitration. (in Turkish)

LAW 303.name: Public International Law
LAW 303.description: Normative factor of international relations; particularly international agreements and international customary law, jurisdictional aspects of international law, settlement of disputes. (in Turkish)

LAW 304.name: Private International Law (in Turkish)
LAW 304.description: Conflict of laws, international procedure law, private international law, citizenship and foreigners' law, recognition and enforcement of foreign judgments and arbitral awards, international jurisdiction of Turkish courts. (in Turkish)

LAW 305.name: Law of Property I (in Turkish)
LAW 305.description: Concept, types and characteristics of property, legal characteristics of possession; acquisition, termination and protection of possession and related claims, land registry; particularly the structure and principles of registry, legal consequences of registration and correction of entries in land registry.

LAW 306.name: Law of Property II (in Turkish)
LAW 306.description: Concept and scope of ownership, protection of ownership, ownership of movable and immovable property; particularly acquisition and loss of ownership, legal characteristics, types, acquisition and termination of limited real rights (servitudes, land charges and pledge).

LAW 307.name: Commercial Enterprise Law (in Turkish)
LAW 307.description: Commercial enterprise, business transaction, commercial provisions, commercial jurisdiction, merchant, trade name, trademark, enterprise name, unfair competition, books of account, checking account, merchant assistants.

LAW 308.name: Company Law (in Turkish)
LAW 308.description: Ordinary partnerships, collective companies, commandite companies, joint stock companies, limited companies.

LAW 309.name: Law of Obligations Special Provisions (in Turkish)
LAW 309.description: Scope and characteristics of special provisions of Turkish Code of Obligations, nominate and innominate contracts, sales contract, rental contract, contract of mandate, bailment contract. (in Turkish)

LAW 313.name: Business Law (in Turkish)
LAW 313.description: Introduction to law, basic concepts of civil law, rights, acquisition of rights via good faith, the principle of good faith, abuse of right, law of persons, capacity to have rights, capacity to act, the origins of obligation, the formation of contracts, validity requirements of contracts, invalidity of contracts, performance of obligations, performance modalities, legal consequences of non-performance, the concept of commercial enterprise and its legal structure, commercial affair and its legal consequences, legal consequences of being a merchant, selected topics concerning business and commercial law. (in Turkish)

LAW 315.name: Administrative Law (in Turkish)
LAW 315.description: Basic political and legal principles of Turkish administrative law and basic principles of judicial control of the administration. Sources of administrative law; structural and functional aspects of central and local administration and regulatory agencies; rule-making power of the administration: unilateral administrative acts; contracts of the administration and legal regime of public personnel. Organization of administrative courts and Council of State and their competences; judicial remedies; liability of the administration and its agents. (in Turkish)

LAW 320.name: Legal Aspects of Blockchain, Crypto Assets and Smart Contracts
LAW 320.description: Distributed ledger technology; blockchain; decentralized finance; Web 3.0; FinTech; LegalTech; Metaverse; artificial intelligence; tokens; smart contracts; NFTs; decentralized autonomous organizations; international trade finance; electronic contracts; algorithmic contracts; Ricardian contracts; contract law; applicable law; property law; copyright; privacy and protection of personal data.

LAW 321.name: Judicial Review and Constitutional Rights: Comparative Perspectives
LAW 321.description: Protection of constitutional rights; fundamental rights and freedoms; judicial review, constitutional/supreme courts; observing judicial practice on same legal disputes in different jurisdictions; legal comparison.

LAW 325.name: Legal History (in Turkish)
LAW 325.description: Main concepts and historical development of Turkish law; Islamic legal practice in Turkish legal history ; Ottoman legal system ; legal reforms in the Tanzimat era ; Codifications during the Tanzimat and Republican periods ; legal revolution in the Republican period and its characteristics; Ottoman legal legacy in the judgments of Turkish high courts; effects of the Treaty of Lausanne on the legal system of the Republic. (in Turkish)

LAW 358.name: Criminal Law Special Provisions (in Turkish)
LAW 358.description: Particular crimes as homicide, assault, sexual offences, theft and related offences, offences of damage to property, offences against constitutional and public order, public health, forgery. (in Turkish)

LAW 359.name: Comparative Private Law (in Turkish)
LAW 359.description: A study and comparative analysis of various legal systems, focusing on the main features of private law. (in Turkish)

LAW 361.name: Legal Ethics and Judiciary Ethics (in Turkish)
LAW 361.description: The meaning of ethics, ethical theories, judicial ethics, basic principles of judicial ethics and legal ethics.

LAW 363.name: International Law and Migration
LAW 363.description: Sources of international migration law. Definitions and concepts. Forms of migration. Migrant rights and State obligations. Migrant smuggling and trafficking. Migration in the EU.

LAW 365.name: Legal Philosophy(in Turkish)
LAW 365.description: Relationship between law, philosophy and science, the scope and subject of legal philosophy, doctrine of "natural law", evaluation of the criticism against legal philosophy on the ground of being metaphysical under modern epistemology, concept of "legal justice" as the natural consequence of legal positivism. (in Turkish)

LAW 366.name: Legal Sociology(in Turkish)
LAW 366.description: Theoretical foundations and main concepts of sociology of law; contemporary debates on law and society; developments and methods in sociology of law; analysis of judicial decisions in the context of the interrelationship between law and society; transformative effects of information technologies on law and society; law, ideology and power. (in Turkish)

LAW 367.name: Philosophy of Law and Sociology of Law (in Turkish)
LAW 367.description: Epistemology of the law, definitions of law according to legal theories, the relationship between law and ethics, justice (Aristoteles, John Rawls), the relationship between law and society, Critical Legal Theory, Feminist Legal Theory, Michael Foucault, Bourdieu.(in Turkish)

LAW 369.name: Specific Aspects of ECHR Protection Mechanism (Context, Implementation and Rights)
LAW 369.description: Background to the adoption of the ECHR, and the development and nature of the ECHR system; application to ECHR and admissibility criteria; organization, practice and procedure before the ECtHR; the nature and effect of ECHR judgments and their enforcement by the Member States; the role of the Secretary General of the Council of Europe and relevant Turkish National Authorities; interpreting and limiting rights and freedoms in the ECHR; selected substantive and procedural rights; Protocol 16 and beyond (in English).

LAW 371.name: International Criminal Law
LAW 371.description: An introduction to the field of international criminal law, Origins of the field, The past and present of the international criminal justice, Conceptual definitions, Jurisdiction and Substantive crimes, Legal discussions on criminal liability, Grounds for excluding criminal liability, Immunities, Practical approach in international criminal tribunals as well as landmark decisions on several topics, A case study- role playing exercise to practice the theoretical discussions throughout the semester.

LAW 374.name: Parliamentary Law (in Turkish)
LAW 374.description: Concept of "parliament", its historical background, formation of the legislative body, unicameral and bicameral systems, electoral systems, size of parliaments, time period between elections, Turkish Parliament, its functions, legal status of the members (that is, representing the nation, parliamentary immunity, termination of membership). (in Turkish)

LAW 375.name: Turkish Constitutional History (in Turkish)
LAW 375.description: 1808 Charter of Alliance (Sened-i Ittifak), 1839 Edict of Tanzimat, 1856 Edict of Islahat, Proclamation of Constitution of 1876, Suspension of the Parliament, Second Constitutionalist Era (1908), 1909 Amendments, World War, Dissolution of the Parliament, Establishment of Grand National Assembly, Constitution of 1921, Proclamation of Republic, Constitution of 1924, Transition to multi-party system, 1960 Military Intervention (coup d'etat), 1961 Constitution, 1971 amendments, 1980 Military Intervention (coup d'état), National Security Council Era, 1982 Constitution, Elections. (in Turkish)

LAW 376.name: Selected Topics in English Law
LAW 376.description: Origins and development of common law, law of equity, sources, relationship between common law and statutory law, precedent, acts of parliament and statutory instruments, court structure of England and Wales, the jury system, judiciary and legal profession in England, English law of contracts (in English).

LAW 377.name: Current Issues in Law of Technology
LAW 377.description: Regulation of technology, the interface between law and technology, basic concepts of technology law. Introduction and legal analysis of selected technological areas including cybersecurity, data protection, artificial intelligence, protection of software and start-ups. Local and global technological developments and their impact on law (in English).

LAW 379.name: Comparative European and Turkish Data Protection Law (in Turkish)
LAW 379.description: Information society; economic value of data; right to privacy and data protection; basic concepts and terminology; scope of General Data Protection Regulation; general principles of data processing; processing of children's data and special categories of data; rights of the data subject; obligations of the data controller and data processor; security of personal data; data protection impact assessment, privacy by design and privacy by default; transfers of personal data to third countries or international organisations; remedies, liabilities and penalties; relevant legal instruments.

LAW 381.name: Construction Law (in Turkish)
LAW 381.description: Formation of construction agreements, construction agreements in return for land share, invalidity, obligations of the contractor and the customer, termination of the contract, withdrawal by the customer against indemnity.

LAW 384.name: Criminology (in Turkish)
LAW 384.description: Deviance and crime; Historical background of criminology; Methods of criminological research; Explanations of criminal behavior. (in Turkish)

LAW 386.name: Law, Film and Literature (in Turkish)
LAW 386.description: The relationship between law, film and literature; how to analyse a film; the idea of justice in film and literature, the analyzis of selected topics in film and literature: family and murder, slavery, portrait of a historical politician, incest and burden of proof; physical integrity, mental illnesses and law, societal development and crime. (in Turkish)

LAW 388.name: Refugee Law and International Protection (in Turkish)
LAW 388.description: Refugee, refugee rights and obligations, asylum, immigration, international protection, principle of non-refoulement, European Court of Human Rights, Turkish Law on Foreigners and International Protection. (in Turkish)

LAW 389.name: The Right to Data Protection (in Turkish)
LAW 389.description: Protection of the right to data protection; legal, ethical, and human rights aspects of data processing; decisions of the ECtHR, the ECJ, and the Turkish Constitutional Court in relation to the right to data protection; the relationship between data protection and other rights and freedoms; theories of surveillance; the protection of health, genetic and biometric data, the right to be forgotten, the protection of children's data; AI and data protection.

LAW 390.name: Individual Application to the Constitutional Court (Merits and Procedure) (in Turkish)
LAW 390.description: Right of individual application to the Constitutional Court; evaluation of provisions of the Constitution and the Act on Constitutional Court; protection of fundamental rights through constitutional justice; decisions of European Court of Human Rights; decisions of the Constitutional Court on individual application; theory of fundamental rights. (in Turkish)

LAW 391.name: Child and the Law
LAW 391.description: Concept of Child; Human Rights of the Child; Development and Protection of Child Rights in National and International Law; Constitution and Child; Civil and Political Rights and Child; Economic and Social Rights and Child; Civil Law and Child; Criminal Law and Child; Labour Law and Child (in Turkish)

LAW 394.name: International Law of the Sea (in Turkish)
LAW 394.description: Baselines, internal waters, territorial sea, straits, contiguous zone, continental shelf, exclusive economic zone, maritime boundaries, delimitation, high seas, international sea bed area, marine pollution, marine environment.

LAW 395.name: World Trade Organization Law
LAW 395.description: This course introduces the students to the basic features of WTO law, including its dispute settlement system, and sheds light on the interaction between Turkish law and WTO law. Specifically, following an overview of all the agreements annexed to the WTO Agreement, the course examines in detail the Agreement on Technical Barriers to Trade, the Agreement on Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures, the Anti-Dumping Agreement, the Agreement on Subsidies and Countervailing Measures, and the Agreement on Safeguards. The WTO's dispute settlement system is also explained at an adequate level of detail. The course finishes with the identification of main issues of importance to Turkey under WTO law.

LAW 396.name: Equality Law (in Turkish)
LAW 396.description: Equality Law, Anti-Discrimination Law, National and International Monitoring Mechanisms, Gender-Based Violence, Discrimination Based on Sexual Orientation, Freedom of Thought, Conscience and Religion, Racial and Ethnic Discrimination, Equality in Workplace.

LAW 400.name: Legal Research Teams
LAW 400.description: Law senior project, faculty-guided small-team legal research; preparing and presenting legal research; team meetings; seminars; research supervision; legal research training; introduction to post-graduate level legal research.

LAW 401.name: Law of Negotiable Instruments (in Turkish)
LAW 401.description: Negotiable instruments, drafts, bonds, bills of exchange. (in Turkish)

LAW 402.name: Insurance Law (in Turkish)
LAW 402.description: Insurance contracts, compulsory insurances, life and property insurances, actuaries and brokers, loss adjusters, insurance agents. (in Turkish)

LAW 403.name: Inheritance Law (in Turkish)
LAW 403.description: Concept of inheritance, deceased, heirship, functions and intentions of inheritance law, the terminology of inheritance law, general principles of inheritance law, legal heirship, testamentary heirship, forced heirship, falcidian portion, protection of falcidian portion, abridgement, discretionary portion, testamentary disposition, the types of testamentary disposition, invalidity of testamentary disposition, interpretation of testamentary disposition, testament, testamentary contract, calculation of succession, hotchpot, protection and administration of succession, co-ownership of heirs, partition of the succession. (in Turkish)

LAW 405.name: International Human Rights Law
LAW 405.description: The course focuses on the protection of human rights at United Nations and European levels. The course will discuss issues including The UN Charter-based System, The UN Treaty-based Systems and The European Regional Human Rights System. (in English).

LAW 406.name: International Commercial Arbitration
LAW 406.description: The sources of international arbitration, the arbitration agreement, the effects of the arbitration agreement, starting an arbitration, the constitution of the arbitral tribunal, arbitral jurisdiction, provisional measures, the taking of the evidence, the award, recognition and enforcement of foreign arbitral awards, standard arbitration rules: the ICC Rules of Arbitration (2017) and the UNCITRAL Rules of Arbitration (2010), comparative law, aspects of Turkish, Swiss, French and English law, aspects of UNCITRAL Model Law.

LAW 407.name: Tax Law (in Turkish)
LAW 407.description: Basic principles of tax law, parties of taxation, process of taxation, valuation, depreciation and equivalents, tax penalties, tax enforcement law, income tax, corporate tax, expenditure taxes: value added tax, special consumption tax, wealth taxes. (in Turkish)

LAW 408.name: Competition Law (in Turkish)
LAW 408.description: Basic concepts of competition law, anti-competitive agreements and concerted practices, abuse of the dominant position, mergers and acquisitions. (in Turkish)

LAW 409.name: Intellectual Property Law (in Turkish)
LAW 409.description: Copyright, industrial property rights: patents, trademarks, geographical indications, industrial designs. Intellectual property law in the EU and in the US. (in Turkish)

LAW 410.name: Enforcement and Bankruptcy Law (in Turkish)
LAW 410.description: The organization of execution office, court orders enforcement, forcing of payments of debts, order of payment, objection, sequestration, forced sale, enforcement for negotiable instruments and bankruptcy. (in Turkish)

LAW 411.name: Criminal Procedure (in Turkish)
LAW 411.description: Jurisdiction; Evidence; Burden of proof; Commencement and conduct of; Proceedings; Legal remedy (review). (in Turkish)

LAW 412.name: Labor Law (in Turkish)
LAW 412.description: Basic concepts of labor law, including the worker, employer, and employment contract, and of the Turkish law on the contractual relationship between the worker and the employer.(in Turkish)

LAW 413.name: European Union Law
LAW 413.description: The institutional and substantive aspects of EU Law; origins, historical evolution, institutions, competences of the EU, legislative procedures and sources of EU law, principles governing the relationship between national law and EU Law; main aspects of free movement of goods, workers, services and capital and the area of freedom, security and justice.

LAW 415.name: Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (in Turkish)
LAW 415.description: Conditions of enforcement and the possible impediments to enforcement, comparative law, international conventions, recognition, Turkish procedural law, arbitration agreement, arbitrability. (in Turkish)

LAW 416.name: Introduction to Contract Law (in Turkish)
LAW 416.description: The concept of contractual obligation, obligational relationship, obligation and liability, legal transactions, declaration of intention, formation of contracts, freedom of contract, form of legal transactions, validity of contracts, interpretation of declarations of intention, representation, standard contract terms, cause of transactions, performance of obligations, legal consequences of non-performance, cease of obligations.

LAW 417.name: Public Procurement Contracts (in Turkish)
LAW 417.description: Public contracts, conclusion of public procurement contracts, invalidity and termination of public procurement contracts (in Turkish).

LAW 418.name: International Sales Law
LAW 418.description: Scope of application of CISG, formation of international sale of goods contracts, obligations of the buyer and the seller, breach of obligations, passing of risk, exemption from liability. (in English)

LAW 419.name: International Law and Armed Conflict
LAW 419.description: Prohibition of use of force and exceptions. Role of UN Security Council. International responsibility. Peacekeeping and peace enforcement operations. Non-forcible means of achieving peace.

LAW 420.name: Turkish International Arbitration Law (in Turkish)
LAW 420.description: The principles of arbitration proceedings with foreign elements which is executed in Turkey, characteristic of arbitration proceedings, provisions of the International Arbitration Act, intervention of the Turkish Courts to the arbitration proceedings and analysis of the arbitral awards and court decisions.

LAW 421.name: Internet Law
LAW 421.description: Legal challenges presented by the internet, fundamentals of Internet technologies and the historical background of the Internet; Internet governance, privacy and data protection, protection of intellectual and industrial property rights online, domain names, cybercrimes, conflict of laws and cross border disputes, ISP Liability under Turkish Law, EU Law and International Law, comparative analysis of the relevant case law.

LAW 422.name: Maritime Law
LAW 422.description: Shipping, Ship (Vessel), Ship Registration and Maritime Property, Shipowner and Master, Maritime Commercial Contracts, Maritime Accidents, Maritime Liens and Claims, Limitation of Liability.

LAW 423.name: Law of Capital Markets (in Turkish)
LAW 423.description: Rules and regulations being applied on the instruments and transactions in the capital market. The concept of capital market, fundamental participants: issuers; investors; instruments; stock market; intermediary institutions, corporate governance, dematerialization of capital market instruments, stock exchanges. (in Turkish)

LAW 427.name: Citizenship and Foreigners Law (in Turkish)
LAW 427.description: Citizenship law, dual nationality, acquisition of Turkish citizenship, foreigners' law, deportation, passport and visa law, status of aliens, nationality, asylum. (in Turkish)

LAW 447.name: Moot Court I
LAW 447.description: International commercial arbitration, CISG, advocacy, student competition.

LAW 448.name: Moot Court II
LAW 448.description: International commercial arbitration, CISG, advocacy, student competition.

LAW 450.name: Introduction to Economic Analysis of Law
LAW 450.description: Law and economics concepts, efficiency and distribution; fundamental concepts of microeconomic theory and game theory; civil law and common law traditions; economic theory of property; bargaining theory; economic theory of tort liability, computing damages; introduction to economic theories of contracts, legal process, crime and punishment.
LAW 450.prerequisite: (ECON 103 and ENG 102) or (ECON 107 and ECON 108 and ENG 102 and (LAW 210 or LAW 211 or LAW 216))

LAW 451.name: Moot Court III
LAW 451.description: International commercial arbitration, CISG, advocacy, student competition.

LAW 452.name: Moot Court IV
LAW 452.description: International commercial arbitration, Convention on the International Sale of Goods (CISG), advocacy, student competition.

LAW 454.name: Consumer Law
LAW 454.description: Economic impact of consumer law, consumer law in EU regulations, protection of consumer interest in The Law on the Protection of the Consumer, consumer contracts; particularly doorstep selling, installment sales, sales through campaigns, packet tours, distance contracts, consumer credits, standard terms in consumer contracts, deficiencies in goods acquired and services provided, right of withdrawal. (in Turkish)

LAW 459.name: Law and Disruptive Innovation
LAW 459.description: Historical and conceptual foundations of disruptive innovation. Critical analysis of how a selected group of legal fields including telecommunications, privacy, and competition have responded to disruptive innovation. Future legal challenges posed by disruptive innovations.(in English)

LAW 465.name: Settlement of Energy Investment Disputes (in Turkish)
LAW 465.description: Energy investments, Host State, Home State, Investor, Bilateral Investment Treaties, Most Favored Nation (MFN) Clause, Washington Convention, Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency (MIGA), Energy Charter Treaty, mechanisms for settlement, arbitration, International Center for Settlement of Investment (ICSID) arbitration, enforcement of arbitral awards. (in Turkish)

LAW 472.name: Patent Law
LAW 472.description: A review of intellectual property, analysis of the patent document, requirements for patentability, infringement and the nature of patent exclusivity, inventorship and ownership issues, patenting strategies, the interface of patent law and competition law, sector specific considerations (in the hi-tech and pharmaceutical sectors).

LAW 473.name: Mergers and Acquisitions
LAW 473.description: Basic concepts and historical background regarding mergers and acquisitions; strategic and financial investors; valuation; negotiation and preparation of the agreements; dispute management, litigation and arbitration in mergers and acquisitions; acquisition finance; competition law and mergers and acquisitions.

LAW 475.name: Financial Technologies Law (FinTech Law)
LAW 475.description: Concept of Fintech; Fintech services and actors; Payment systems, payment services and e-money; Open banking, banking-as-a-service and neo-banks, Crypto-assets and service providers; Alternative finance; Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs), RegTech, Financial security.

LAW 476.name: Legal Research, Analysis and Writing
LAW 476.description: Legal research, legal analysis, legal reasoning, legal writing, legal argumentation, case analysis, oral argumentation.(in Turkish)

LAW 482.name: European and International Migration Law (in Turkish)
LAW 482.description: Key concepts of migration, its types; legal and irregular migration; concepts of migrant, refugee, international protection; sources of migration law; key international aspects of legal and irregular migration; the UN Global Compact for Safe, Orderly and Regular Migration. Status and rights of legal and irregular migrants in EU Law. Rights of Turkish migrants. The readmission agreement between the EU and Turkey, visa liberalisation process, the EU Facility for Refugees in Turkey.

LAW 484.name: Public Economic Law (in Turkish)
LAW 484.description: Characteristics and sources of public economic law; the law of the state intervention in the economy; fundamental principles of public economic law; public organization in the economy area; public law framework of the market economy and the transition period from interventionist state to regulatory state; and privatization of public economic enterprises, the legal mechanisms of public-private partnership in public services and the regulation of sectors. (in Turkish)

LAW 488.name: Sports Law
LAW 488.description: Autonomy of sport, Organising sport, Sport and the Law: the State, Sport and the Law: the EU, Sport rules, Dispute settlement, Discipline, Sporting integrity, Mega-events, Sport and intellectual property, Sport and human rights, E-sport.

LAW 501.name: Economic Analysis of Law (in Turkish)
LAW 501.description: Concepts of "risk aversion" and "diminishing marginal utility income", economic analysis of contract law - economic function of law of contracts, economic analysis of tort law, cost and benefit analysis, external effects, rational choice theory in law and economics, concept of "risk allocation", damage compensation rule, concept of "economic efficiency", property rule versus liability rule, concept of "optimal level of care", negligence, strict liability, judgment proof problem.

LAW 503.name: Economics of Competition
LAW 503.description: The firm and cost concepts; perfectly competitive and monopolistically competitive markets, monopolies, monopsonies, dominant firms, network externalities and essential facilities; oligopolies and cartels; industry structure and performance; basics of EU and US antitrust rules; functions and structure of the Turkish Competition Authority; horizontal and vertical mergers and acquisitions, privatization and liberalization processes.

LAW 504.name: Competition Law (in Turkish)
LAW 504.description: Basic concepts of competition law, anti-competitive agreements and concerted practices, abuse of the dominant position, mergers and acquisitions; decisions of the Turkish Competition Board, Turkish Conseil d'Etat, European Commission, European Court of Justice, US Supreme Court. (in Turkish)

LAW 505.name: Economic Regulation and Law
LAW 505.description: Information about basic pricing theory, concept of market failure, regulation theory and its alternatives, regulatory process and institutional framework, scope of regulation and sharing of responsibilities, and methods of application of regulation in related markets such as price, transportation and consumer protection.

LAW 506.name: Energy Law and Policy (in Turkish)
LAW 506.description: Legal aspects and development of electric, natural gas, petroleum and LPG industries; legal and economic analysis of these industries; license, tariff and monitoring mechanisms regarding these industries; relation between energy sector and environment. (in Turkish)

LAW 507.name: Public Economic Law (in Turkish)
LAW 507.description: Characteristics and sources of public economic law; the law of the state intervention in the economy; fundamental principles of public economic law; public organization in the economy area; public law framework of the market economy and the transition period from interventionist state to regulatory state; and privatization of public economic enterprises, the legal mechanisms of public-private partnership in public services and the regulation of sectors. (in Turkish)

LAW 508.name: Telecommunications Law
LAW 508.description: Economic concepts of telecommunications regulation; EU telecommunications regime and Turkish telecommunications law; telecommunications law in the UK and the US; authorization and licensing, access and interconnection, spectrum management, capacity agreements, consumer protection; competition law in telecommunications; internet service providers, content liability, control, and neutrality; convergence, broadcast regulation and telecommunications. (in Turkish)

LAW 509.name: Term Project
LAW 509.description: Accomplishment of a research project related to one of the courses, submission of the project in the form of a written report.

LAW 510.name: Banking Regulation Law (in Turkish)
LAW 510.description: Definition of bank, types of banks, main characteristics and functions of banks, legal provisions about banking sector, risks and precautions in banking sector, regulation of banking sector, Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency (BRSA). (in Turkish)

LAW 512.name: Medical Law (in Turkish)
LAW 512.description: Medical Law and Biomedicine Ethics; Right to Health and Patient Rights; Medical Malpractice and Legal Responsibility; Technological Advancements and Oviedo Standards of Biomedicine Ethics; Reproductive Rights, Artificial WombTechnology and Human Cloning; Right to Treatment and Access to Medicine.

LAW 514.name: Data Protection Law (in Turkish)
LAW 514.description: The protection of the right to data protection; the legal, ethical, and human rights aspects of data processing; court and data protection authority decisions; thematic subjects including the protection of health, genetic, and biometric data; the right to be forgotten; and emerging challenges such as artificial intelligence, neurotechnology and data protection.

LAW 515.name: Offences Against the Reliability and Functioning of the Public Administration (in Turkish)
LAW 515.description: Offences Against the Reliability and Functioning of the Public Administration, Embezzlement, Extortion, Bribery, Trading Influence, Misuse of Public Duty, Public Officer, Public Administration.

LAW 516.name: International Tax Law and Global Tax Policy

LAW 517.name: Right to a Fair Trial (in Turkish)

LAW 518.name: Emerging Challenges in International Criminal Law

LAW 520.name: Capital Markets and Market Abuse (in Turkish)
LAW 520.description: The concept of market, price formation mechanisms, market abuses: insider trading and manipulation, sanctions for abuses: criminal and legal liabilities, market oriented approach, regulation approach in the European Union. (in Turkish)

LAW 521.name: Law and Democracy in the 21st Century: Influence, Money and Technology

LAW 530.name: Unfair Competition (in Turkish)
LAW 530.description: Regulation of the unfair competition in the European Union, in Switzerland, in Germany and in Turkey; relation to the other right zone, especially to the competition law and law of the intellectual property; faithfully and belief; confusion, protection of know-how and against the abuse of fabrication secrets or business secrets; non-observance of work conditions; specials cases of the unfair competition through advertising, sponsorship; sanction in the right of the unfair competition and consumer right.

LAW 534.name: Patent Law
LAW 534.description: Introduction to intellectual property, analysis of the patent document, requirements for patentability, infringement and the nature of patent exclusivity, inventorship and ownership issues, patenting strategies, the interface of patent law and competition law, and sector specific considerations (in the hi-tech and pharmaceutical sectors).

LAW 540.name: Real Estate Market Law (in Turkish)
LAW 540.description: Importance of the subject matter; concepts of property, immovable property and property law; concept of property from a legal, philosophical and economic perspective; economic analysis of property law; rights on immovable property; obligation and liability, security, lien; liens on immovable property; liens on movable property and on rights or claims; bonds that are issued with a security on immovable property according to the Turkish Civil Code; concept of market; market of immovable property; markets in which immovable property changes hands; markets in which instruments based on securities on immovable property change hands, capital markets; basic concepts of the law of capital markets; real estate finance; housing finance. (in Turkish)

LAW 544.name: The Legal Framework of Social Dialogue (in Turkish)
LAW 544.description: Social dialogue, the "making" of EU Labor Law .The need for EU initiatives on social issues: European social dialogue: core concepts and mechanisms; structural and functional legal analysis. Rights to share information, to be consulted, to decide jointly, to produce joint opinions. Tripartite and bipartite platforms for dialogue. (in Turkish)

LAW 546.name: Current Issues in Labor Law (in Turkish)
LAW 546.description: Current developments in labor law in relation to the developing world, where there are no restrictions in the international movement of capital, goods, services and technology; establishing balance between the social partners; new labor administration that includes a new system of labor inspection; the changing roles of workers' and employers' organizations; modernization of labor law; flexicurity; non-typical work; social dialogue; and conciliation.

LAW 548.name: Basic Elements and Principles of Limited Liability Companies (in Turkish)
LAW 548.description: Limited liability companies, history and function of limited liability company, limited liability company as a type of capital company, basic elements of limited liability company, company foundation, importance of company's organ structure, liquidation of the company.

LAW 550.name: Fundamentals of Legal Thought (in Turkish)
LAW 550.description: Natural law: basic readings on some of the great thinkers defending the natural law view; concepts of natural rights, de officiis, the importance of natural law. Positive law, basic readings on some of the great thinkers who defend positive law view; concepts of legality, social contract, utilitarianism, relation between economy and law, justice. Legal method (language): legal relations, normativism, legal system, argumentum, antinomies, T\^{u} T\^{u}, force of law.

LAW 551.name: Current Issues on Immovable Property Law
LAW 551.description: Current issues on Property Rights, Land Registry, the Right of Pre-emption, Condominium, Urban Regeneration, Rent of Immovable Property, Sustainability and Digitalization in Immovable Property Law. (in Turkish)

LAW 554.name: Comparative Law of Torts (in Turkish)
LAW 554.description: The elements of tort, the relationship between contractual liability and tort, establishment of liability and the process of determining the compensation, items of damage, calculations/tables of compensation, strict liability-liability of dangerous activities, tort cases.

LAW 561.name: New Developments in Non-Performance Law (in Turkish)
LAW 561.description: Impossibility, Bad Performance, Debtor's Default, Non-performance in Comparative Law Regulations . (in Turkish)

LAW 562.name: Legal and Administrative Aspects of Privatization (in Turkish)
LAW 562.description: The emergence of the concept of privatization and its theoretical basis. The formation of legal and administrative basis of privatization. The methods of privatization of property, management and finance. Privatization of public services, the model of Built-Operate-Transfer and other Public-Private Partnership models. Analysis of important decisions given by Constitutional Court and Council of State on privatization. Analysis of privatization methods in certain areas such as privatization of harbors and postal services.

LAW 565.name: Protection Mechanism of the ECHR (Historical Process and Implementation) (in Turkish)
LAW 565.description: Historical overview of the Council of Europe, historical overview of the ECHR system, functional analysis of the fundamental rights protection system within the CoE, main principles of the ECHR system, content of the Convention and the Protocols, jurisprudence of the ECHR, discussion of the leading case law analysis of the ECHR.

LAW 567.name: Parliamentary Law (in Turkish)
LAW 567.description: Concept of "parliament", its historical background, formation of the legislative body, unicameral and bicameral systems, electoral systems, size of parliaments, time period between elections, Turkish Parliament, its functions, legal status of the members (that is, representing the nation, parliamentary immunity, termination of membership).

LAW 568.name: Contemporary Governmental Systems (in Turkish)
LAW 568.description: Typologies of many governmental systems, presidential system, parliamentary system, semi-presidentialism, super-presidentialism, prime-minister presidentialism, presidential-parliamentary system.

LAW 569.name: Public Procurement Contracts (in Turkish)
LAW 569.description: Public contracts, conclusion of Public procurement contracts, invalidity and termination of public procurement contracts (in Turkish).

LAW 571.name: Law Applicable to Contractual Obligations (in Turkish)
LAW 571.description: Applicable law, contractual obligations, conflict of laws, choice of law, party autonomy, CISG, characteristic obligation, place of performance, most closely connected law, publicy order, proper law, renvoi, consumer contracts, labour contracts, mandatory rules, lex mercatoria, incorporation, INCOTERMS, principles of European Contract Law, Roma I Regulation of EU, The Hague Convention Law Applicable to the Sales Contracts, Letter of Credits, UCP 600, Uniform Commercial Code, Restatement 2nd.

LAW 572.name: General Conflict of Laws Rules (in Turkish)
LAW 572.description: Conflict of laws, ex officio application of foreign law, renvoi, Locus Regit Actum, Statute of Limitation, Qualification and Characterization, choice of law, party autonomy, public policy, International Conventions, Lex causae, Lex fori, escape clauses, the Hague Conventions, connecting factor, preliminary questions, fraus legit facta, domicile, nationality, habitual residence.

LAW 573.name: Establishment and Implementation of Contracts (in Turkish)
LAW 573.description: Contract, establishment of a contract, will, declaration of will, standardized terms of contract, interpretation of a contract, implementation of a contract, legal characterisation of a contract, legal gap-filling. (in Turkish)

LAW 580.name: Legal Methodology (in Turkish)
LAW 580.description: Designing a legal research question, determining research materials and tools, formatting and principles of academic writing (citation principles, bibliography), good legal writing, interpretation methods in law, comparative law method.

LAW 590.name: Pre-Thesis Seminar
LAW 590.description: Presentation on the preliminary results of the graduate thesis work, participation in the presentations given by other classmates.

LAW 599.name: Master's Thesis
LAW 599.description: A research-based thesis course on an individual project. Timely, relevant and substantial research on a topic in the general area of law .Topic to be agreed in consultation with a Master Thesis advisor.

LAW 605.name: Constitutional Judiciary (in Turkish)
LAW 605.description: Functions of constitutional review and its relation to democracy, status of constitutional courts in political systems, the problem of constitutional court as "political actor", the problem of judicial activism and judicial self-restraint, rigid constitutions, protection of legal and political system by the means of constitutional review. (in Turkish)

LAW 609.name: Fundamental Issues in Criminal Law (in Turkish)
LAW 609.description: Elements of crime; Attempt; Accomplicity; Offender; Punishment; Current issues in criminal law. (in Turkish)

LAW 610.name: ICSID Arbitration (in Turkish)
LAW 610.description: Foreign direct investments, International Center for Settlement of Investment (ICSID) arbitration, additional facility rules, ICSID cases against Turkey, settlement of state-investor disputes, jurisdiction of ICSID, enforcement of ICSID arbitral awards, World Bank. (in Turkish)

LAW 612.name: Bound Enterprises Law ( Company Groups Law ) (in Turkish)
LAW 612.description: Provisions of Turkish Commercial Code for group of companies, dominant and affiliated companies, legal independence-economic dependence, main concepts such as dominance, types and tools of dominance, contracts between group companies, special protection for shareholders within the provisions of Turkish Commercial Code for group of companies, supervision and disclosure requirements, liabilities specially designed for group of companies. (in Turkish)

LAW 614.name: Shareholder Rights (in Turkish)
LAW 614.description: Concepts of "share" and "shareholder" in joint stock companies, acquisition and loss of the title of "shareholder", types and categorization of shareholder rights, limitations on exercise of shareholder rights, concept of "minority rights", violation of shareholder rights and general principles of protection of shareholders (in Turkish).

LAW 619.name: Comparative Constitutional Law (in Turkish)
LAW 619.description: Historical development of the modern constitutional state, the constitutional theory of the nation-state ,new forms of sovereignty, the restructuring of sovereignty from the nation-state to the EU constitutional state and its relationship to sovereignty in the jurisprudence of the Turkish Constitutional Court.

LAW 622.name: Preservation of Assets in Corporations (in Turkish)
LAW 622.description: Preservation of assets in joint stock companies, assets of joint stock companies, capital ofjoint stock companies, the relationship between the capital and assets of a joint-stock company, significance of preserving assets for joint-stock companies.

LAW 624.name: International Procedure (in Turkish)
LAW 624.description: International Jurisdiction of state courts, The European Agreement concerning the International Carriage of Dangerous foods by Road (ADR), Arbitration, Recognition and Enforcement of arbitral awards, Subject matter jurisdiction of domestic courts in international disputes, exorbitant jurisdiction of the courts, annulment of arbitral awards. (in Turkish)

LAW 633.name: Individual Application to the Constitutional Court (Merits and Procedure) (in Turkish)
LAW 633.description: Individual application to the Constitutional Court; Analysis of the Law on and By-Law of the Constitutional Court; substantive and procedural conditions of individual application; analysis of selected decisions of the Constitutional Court; effects and implementation of Constitutional Court decisions.

LAW 634.name: Methodology of Law (in Turkish)
LAW 634.description: Materials and tools for legal studies, methods and principles on shaping ideas and writing papers, function of comparative law and methodological considerations, legal hermeneutic. (in Turkish)

LAW 635.name: Corporate Governance Issues of Joint Stock Companies (in Turkish)
LAW 635.description: Corporate governance, history and function of corporate governance, basic principles of corporate governance regarding protection of shareholders, public disclosure and transparency, corporate governance rules on capital markets law, the issues concerning corporate governance.

LAW 637.name: Corporate Finance Law (in Turkish)
LAW 637.description: The methods of corporate finance; equity financing; debt financing; position of shareholders; position of creditors; legal capital, shareholder protection; creditor protection; credit contracts.

LAW 644.name: Private Law Remedies in Competition Law (in Turkish)
LAW 644.description: The prohibitive provisions of competition law; the role and weight of the private enforcement of such provisions within the frame of the purpose of competition law; the legal requirements, nature and consequences of the invalidity of the cartels, anti-competitive vertical agreements between undertakings and anti-competitive decisions of undertakings' associations; anti-competitive collusions, especially cartels, and anti-competitive unilateral practices (abuse of dominant position) as torts; damages and punitive damages as remedies of tortious anti-competitive practices; culpa in contrahendo as an anti-competitive practice and damages arising therefrom; time limitation of damages; private law consequences of prohibited mergers and acquisitions; particular problems in civil procedure law : all will be elaborated on grounds of the civil law remedies provided for in The Act Numbered 4054 On Protection Of Competition, of the rules of The Code Of Obligations that still apply, of the competition law specific concepts and of the general dogmatic principles of contract and tort law, with references to other jurisdictions, especially to the developments and stand in the EU countries. (in Turkish)

LAW 646.name: Current Issues on Criminal Procedure Law (in Turkish)
LAW 646.description: Procedure Law, Criminal Law, Criminal Procedure Law, Human Rights, Measures of Protection, Evidence, Investigation, Trial, Prosecution.

LAW 680.name: Current Issues on Private Law (in Turkish)
LAW 680.description: Current issues and new developments in private law. The specific content determined by the instructors.

LAW 682.name: Current Issues on Public Law (in Turkish)
LAW 682.description: Current issues and new developments in public law with specific content to be determined by instructors.

LAW 689.name: Pre-Thesis Seminar
LAW 689.description: Presentation on the preliminary results of the graduate thesis work, participation in the presentations given by other classmates.

LAW 699.name: Ph.D. Dissertation
LAW 699.description: A research-based thesis course on an individual project. Timely, relevant, novel and substantial research on a topic in the general area of law .Topic to be agreed in consultation with a Ph.D. advisor. Principal authorship of at least one archival publication in a leading journal.
